about: Wording a decision retired. check:spec fails when a pattern matches in docs/ or README.md outside the sections listed in `allow` (ids of enclosing headings or index rows: D-13, TH-33, SP-24, protocol 4.6). `known` lists matches kept on purpose until an open gap is decided; each must still match, so a fixed gap forces its entry out. Add entries in the ripple step of the protocol-change workflow.

terms.pattern: \bgrants?\b
terms.use: the version's roster; every access change is a rotation

terms.pattern: \bcompleteRotation\b
terms.use: a rotation is one record

terms.pattern: \b[Cc]ontinuity (signature|hint|proof)s?\b|: member keys, continuity
terms.use: proofs are `recovery` or none

terms.pattern: \b[Ii]nvite proofs?\b|\bjoin secret\b|\bautoApproveInvites\b
terms.use: an invite link carries only the team's anchor

terms.pattern: \b(server|it) deletes\b|\bdeletes? (its|the|their) (device's )?wraps?\b|\bwraps? (is|are) deleted\b|\bdeleted on revoke\b|\b[Dd]eleted with its account key version\b
terms.use: the server stops serving the record and archives it (rule 7)

terms.pattern: secureAccount\(\{ phrase, newPin \}\)|\bask for the PIN once\b|\bthey enter the PIN, and\b
terms.use: the PIN is optional when the phrase is given: `secureAccount({ phrase, newPin? })`

terms.pattern: \blisted owners hold\b
terms.use: the server checks the signer of a new version, not the owners it lists

terms.pattern: \bthe current one or a new one\b|\bdrops the recovery wrap\b|rotate\(\{ pin|\bwithout the phrase, recovery must\b
terms.use: `rotate({ phrase, newPin? })` needs the phrase and keeps it

terms.pattern: doesn't match its own keys \(`key_mismatch`\)|\bmemberKeysVersion` \+ 1\b
terms.use: new keys take the newest published version plus one; foreign keys are reported (`foreign-member-keys`)

terms.pattern: openTeam\([^)]*\{ anchor
terms.use: the invite anchor goes to `joinTeam(teamId, { anchor })`; the bundle's floor carries it

terms.pattern: floor, or, if it has none|keeps? the anchor floor|keeping the anchor floor|floor only when it has no|(?:on|stays on) first contact until
terms.use: the floor is the newest trusted anchor when the bundle is written, and counts unless it is below the lowest other anchor

terms.pattern: floors, the local anchor and|the vault's local anchor and the account's|transfer carries it\b|with the bundles' floors as in
terms.use: the floor at a re-key or rotation comes from the bundles' floors and the team-state anchor only; the transfer carries the floor set at join, and §6.1 uses the newest bundle's floor

terms.pattern: newest trusted anchor|newest anchor the (?:vault|account)|unless it is below the lowest|never adds a download|floor counts unless|the team's floor, the newest
terms.use: the floor is the root of trust: always counted, moved only to the tip of a chain verified from it (vault open or export, re-key), kept by a rotation

terms.pattern: currentKeyId|separate OPRF key per account|per-account OPRF key|server's current one|base mode|key specific to (?:this|the) account
terms.use: one POPRF key pair per oprfKeyId, info built from the account; the key id new wraps use is the settings' writeKeyId

terms.pattern: floor stays the current one|else the current floor|from this device's local anchor when it has one|matters only if someone also holds that old
terms.use: a floor is written only from a chain containing every root (the floor and the vault's own anchor), or from an owner's anchor; a conflict fails the re-key; the retired-version limit holds whenever someone has the old key

terms.pattern: memberKeysVersion \}`, which every approval takes
terms.use: the handle names the keys hash too: `{ accountId, memberKeysVersion, keysHash }`

terms.pattern: naming the `memberKeysVersion` reviewed
terms.use: naming the keys reviewed, by version and keys hash

terms.pattern: with the phrase, proven \(§6\.8\): the current one or the old one
terms.use: `phrase` is the current phrase; `oldPhrase` signs a retry after a replacement

terms.pattern: check `wrappedRecoveryPublicKey` against the phrase
terms.use: a stored recovery key that differs from the typed phrase's is reported, never refused

terms.pattern: newer than the (client's )?highest anchor
terms.use: every record above the lowest root

terms.pattern: and the bundles the vault holds, or 1 for none
terms.use: numbered from published records only

terms.pattern: this account's last verified state
terms.use: since this device or context last verified the team

terms.pattern: otherwise it counts as an anchor
terms.use: otherwise it is consistent with the chain

terms.pattern: A first recovery setup \(§5\.10\) takes none
terms.use: a first setup takes the current PIN

terms.pattern: a first setup none
terms.use: a first setup the PIN

terms.pattern: never silently ignored, since ignoring it
terms.use: with a floor, an unreadable team-state is absent and replaced

terms.pattern: if it can read it, rewrites
terms.use: with a floor, the next anchor advance rewrites a team-state under older keys

terms.pattern: until another owner is added
terms.use: a listed owner steps down first (setOwners)

terms.pattern: Add another owner first
terms.use: Step down first

terms.pattern: a vault that has opened or exported the team refuses it
terms.use: refuses a floor written directly, not one given through the open vault (review 037 D)

terms.pattern: an anchor from an owner repairs it, also on a device with no anchor
terms.use: repairs the device that runs the repair; a server can still serve a new device the planted wrap (review 037 E)
